_comment: Advisory trigger evals for analyzing-products — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Covers the two modes (URL extract, photo analysis) plus negatives that must NOT fire: plain generation and unrelated asks. This is a building-block skill, usually called by other skills.

cases.query: extract the product details from this amazon link
pull the product info and images from this shopify product page
analyze this product photo and tell me how it's used
normalize the product from this aliexpress url before we generate
what is this product and how does the container open
generate an image of a red bicycle in a city street
make a video of waves crashing on a beach
what's the weather in Tokyo today
